Audit an estimator's empirical power curve across an effect-size grid

Source: R/audit-power.R
audit_power_curve.Rd

Simulates datasets across a grid of true effect sizes effect_grid and audits: (1) empirical rejection probability with exact Clopper-Pearson 95% confidence intervals and Monte Carlo standard errors, (2) Type-I error calibration at effect = 0 (when present in effect_grid), (3) statistical monotonicity of empirical power as effect magnitude increases (via MCSE-adjusted two-proportion z-tests so Monte Carlo noise does not trigger spurious failures), and (4) achievement of target_power at target_effect, along with linear-interpolated minimum detectable effect (mde).

Usage

audit_power_curve(
  dgp,
  test_fn,
  effect_grid,
  param = NULL,
  n_sim = 100L,
  alpha = 0.05,
  target_power = 0.8,
  target_effect = NULL,
  check_monotonic = TRUE,
  check_null_type1 = TRUE,
  seed = 42L,
  mc_alpha = 0.01
)

Arguments

dgp

Function function(effect) generating a dataset for the given numeric effect size.

test_fn

Function function(data) returning either a scalar numeric p-value, a logical scalar (TRUE = reject), a list containing $p_value or $p.value, or an htest, lm, glm, or lmerMod object.

effect_grid

Numeric vector of at least two effect sizes to evaluate (e.g., c(0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)).

param

Optional character parameter name when test_fn returns an lm, glm, or lmerMod object with multiple predictors (defaults to the first non-intercept coefficient).

n_sim

Integer number of Monte Carlo replications per grid point (default 100L).

alpha

Nominal two-sided significance level (default 0.05).

target_power

Target statistical power threshold (default 0.80).

target_effect

Optional numeric effect size in effect_grid at which target_power must be achieved. If NULL, no target-power gate is enforced (though mde is still estimated).

check_monotonic

Logical; if TRUE (default), verify empirical power does not drop significantly as abs(effect) increases.

check_null_type1

Logical; if TRUE (default) and 0 is included in effect_grid, audit Type-I error calibration against alpha.

seed

Integer RNG seed for reproducibility (default 42L).

mc_alpha

Exact binomial / Monte Carlo failure significance threshold (default 0.01).

Value

An S3 object of class "statci_power_curve" containing curve (a tibble::tibble), monotonicity, target_check, null_check, mde, settings, and overall status ("pass", "warn", or "fail").

Examples

pc <- audit_power_curve(
  dgp = function(d) rnorm(40, mean = d, sd = 1),
  test_fn = function(y) t.test(y, mu = 0),
  effect_grid = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
  n_sim = 80L,
  target_effect = 0.5,
  target_power = 0.80,
  seed = 42L
)
pc
#> [PASS] statci Power-Curve Audit (4 grid points, n_sim = 80, MDE(80%) = 0.528)
#> effect = 0.000: power = 8.8% [3.6%, 17.2%] (MCSE = 0.032)
#> effect = 0.250: power = 33.8% [23.6%, 45.2%] (MCSE = 0.053)
#> effect = 0.500: power = 77.5% [66.8%, 86.1%] (MCSE = 0.047)
#> effect = 0.750: power = 100.0% [95.5%, 100.0%] (MCSE = 0.000)
#> [PASS] Null Type-I error: 8.8% (binom p = 0.1218)
#> [PASS] Monotonicity: 0 significant drop(s) (max drop z = 0.00)
#> [PASS] Target power (80% at effect = 0.500): achieved 77.5%
